lineage.protocol: F3 native + F3 in (lambda,beta,k*); GLS; replicate bootstrap

banked-curve mismatches vs the sealed en.name: banked-curve mismatches vs the sealed ensemble (80 numbers)

worst |k* direct - k* derived| in units.name: worst |k* direct - k* derived| in units of the direct fit's own sigma
worst |k* direct - k* derived| in units.why: a discrepancy in the fit's own uncertainty; 100 a practical ceiling. 1.0 sigma is a genuine reproduction bar for two parameterizations of the same curve at the same window

max over classes of |corr(beta, k*)| at.name: max over classes of |corr(beta, k*)| at the sealed window
max over classes of |corr(beta, k*)| at.why: a correlation magnitude, [0,1] by construction; 0.80 is well below the native 0.98-0.99 and well above what noise would give on two genuinely orthogonal parameters

shrinkages at which GLS chi2/dof >= OLS.name: shrinkages at which GLS chi2/dof >= OLS chi2/dof for iid
shrinkages at which GLS chi2/dof >= OLS.why: a count over the 4 shrinkages; 3.5 requires all four. If GLS brought chi2/dof toward 1 at any shrinkage, the misfit would be attributable to the error structure

max over classes of bootstrap-cloud |cor.name: max over classes of bootstrap-cloud |corr(tau,beta)| at B=8000, k=5..11
max over classes of bootstrap-cloud |cor.why: a correlation magnitude, [0,1]. The covariance reads 0.999 there. MET: the bootstrap does not resolve the flat direction and the 'blind' claim is earned. MISSED: it was under-resampling. Bar set before these rows were seen

params.name: parameterization
params.why: THE axis. Native F3 vs F3 with tau eliminated through the level crossing, so the (beta, k*) pair can be judged for conditioning against the (tau, beta) pair

params.name: gls_shrinkage
params.why: the sample covariance at R=16 over a 16-point window is rank-deficient, so a shrinkage is forced; the discriminator must hold across the sweep or it holds at a choice

params.name: bootstrap_B
params.why: the structural-vs-under-resampling question IS a question about B; a single B cannot answer it

params.name: synthetic_range
params.why: whether the native degeneracy is a window effect is tested on exact-F3 data over increasing ranges, up to 22 decades

params.name: degeneracy_threshold
params.why: the fork's declared threshold (verify_errormodel); carried verbatim so this cell and the fork agree on what degenerate means

scope: RECERT_SCOPE Stage 3e. Identifiability of F3's shape parameters, from banked data. Runs no flows; re-grades nothing. Disclosed prior look on all but C3's short-window rows.
